title: XCT-SAM: Sequential Parameter-Efficient Domain Adaptation of SAM for Industrial XCT Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Sequential PEFT stages adapt SAM first to the general modality and then to the defect task, under severe class imbalance and scan-condition shift.
adaptation: Greyscale industrial defects, closest industrial match. Stage 1 adapter on all EL data (5 sources + UCF-EL crack/inactive region masks), stage 2 adapter on BenchmarkEL 24 classes with stage 1 frozen, to keep the broad EL features for E1.
min_experiment: Arm: two-stage PEFT on VFM-H. Baseline: single-stage VFM-H and house PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, CV crack relF1@2. Kill: E1 relF1@2 not +0.02 over single stage or CV drop > 0.005.
evidence: R: abstract fragment only; additive-manufacturing XCT; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: partial: UCF-EL encoder pretraining was erased by the house fine-tune (n.d.); a frozen-stage adapter keeps it, which BRIEF lists as open.
